subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: Should a QQ Bot direct C2C callback itself grant approval authority when the sender is absent from every explicit non-wildcard command or approval allowlist?
rationale: Current documentation and the security fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87154 require explicit actor authorization, while the paired PR proposes treating conversation type as sufficient trust.

options.title: Preserve explicit authorization
options.body: Keep the current security boundary and improve the rejected-button UX with in-chat configuration guidance or by withholding unusable approval actions.

options.title: Trust direct C2C callbacks
options.body: Accept direct-chat identity as approval authority and require live QQ proof plus focused security review before landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107595.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit authorization
recommendation.body: Keep the current security boundary and improve the rejected-button UX with in-chat configuration guidance or by withholding unusable approval actions.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the exact authorization gate and documented security rationale now being reconsidered.
